description.en: Specifies whether to display the details of diagnostic items.

The end timestamp of the query. Unit: milliseconds.
- Minimum value: 1000000000000
- Maximum value: 2000000000000.

description.zh:
获取的报告的语言。默认为浏览器语言，支持：

- en：英语
- zh：简体中文
- zt：繁体中文
- es：西班牙语
- fr：法语
description.en:
The language of the reports to retrieve. Default value: the browser language. Valid values:

- en: English
- zh: Simplified Chinese
- zt: Traditional Chinese
- es: Spanish
- fr: French.

description.zh: 分页数。默认值：1，最小值：1，最大值：200。
description.en: The page number. Default value: 1. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 200.

description.zh: 每页报告数。默认值：10，最小值：1，最大值：500。
description.en: The number of reports per page. Default value: 10. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 500.

The start timestamp of the query. Unit: milliseconds.

- Minimum value: 1000000000000
- Maximum value: 2000000000000.

description.zh:
健康诊断的触发方式，支持：

- SYSTEM（默认）：系统自动触发
- INNER：内部触发
- USER：用户手动触发
description.en:
The trigger method of the health diagnostics. Valid values:

- SYSTEM (default): automatically triggered by the system
- INNER: internally triggered
- USER: manually triggered by the user.

title.zh: 智能运维的历史报告列表
